scope: Versioned default source selection for registered factual questions over all existing quantitative layers; raw values and phase2 comparison decisions remain unchanged.
selection_principles: Choose a registered purpose and population before prioritizing sources. Purpose-specific defaults are curator rules, not official corrections.
Selection as an original period fact is separate from permission to connect a time series. source_series_only may supply original period facts but never becomes published_panel_limited.
All source versions must match explicitly reviewed source_id/SHA/evidence; new versions require policy review. A missing value or smaller number cannot lower source priority.

For a trend purpose, qualify original definitions/units/periods before edition rank. Missing values alone do not disqualify a panel; a newer edition with an explicit definition conflict cannot displace an older qualified original panel. Always disclose excluded newer editions. An explicit source_id pin forbids fallback to another edition.

Latest-panel recipes choose a complete original published panel covering an explicitly requested year interval, then the newest recorded edition. If no one panel covers it, return an unresolved range and alternatives, not a spliced trend.
With no requested interval, latest-panel recipes choose the latest registered original edition. Equal-priority distinct bundles remain ambiguous even if their values agree.
Fixed-scope recipes retain every matched original period fact and every original missing representation. They do not aggregate totals/components or substitute another family.
Unknown or conflicting formal year/month stays unknown; source catalogue year and publication year are not observation year. 2012 county original quantities remain a gap.
Original reported zero, blank, marker, display/typed conflict and unknown unit are distinct. point_value is nullable; raw original values are always preserved.
Trend edges require phase2.compare==published_panel_limited, a shared original group and adjacent valid calendar periods. Gaps break lines; no interpolation.
All unsupported original scopes stay in the complete record-route inventory with reasons; no-default does not mean official data do not exist.

Query trend_summary explicitly states whether one continuous original series exists. selected=true and full year-position coverage are not numeric completeness or permission to connect all selected records.

outputs.record_routes: One row per phase2 record_key exactly once, all three quantitative layers.
outputs.candidate_decisions: One row per registered profile and matched source record, including selected/missing/unusable/alternative/blocked/ambiguous decisions.
outputs.queries: One default-query summary per registered profile; selected IDs must exactly match candidate decisions.
outputs.series_edges: Candidate links between consecutive valid selected time positions inside an original P2 group. Only drawable=true permits a line; that also requires adjacent calendar periods and phase2.compare==published_panel_limited. Unknown periods create no invented edge.

updating: Source-group route cache, per-profile policy bindings, input signature; no-op skips builders, code/metadata-only changes do not claim raw statistical changes. Failure restores previous bytes/mtime. Refresh shared earlier documentation hashes only after success.
publication: v0.8.0 after verification; existing repository only, old tags/releases retained, safe manifest whitelist, CI and full anonymous archive readback, all existing readers/version entry points and private Drive handoff. No source originals/contacts/private routing in the public bundle.
